paper_title: Search for dark photons using a multilayer dielectric haloscope equipped with a single-photon avalanche diode
notes: Multilayer dielectric haloscope (MuDHI) searching for dark photon DM near 1.5 eV. Only the minimum exclusion value is quoted numerically in text: chi < 6.86e-11 at 1.61 eV/c^2 (90% CL).
